body:
Closes SOFT-2929

Cause: Claude Code holds a message while a turn is still running. A slash command waits for the turn to end, and plain text is read at the next tool step, so its transcript row only appears when Claude takes the message. The desktop retired its local sent copy on the next reply, before that row existed, so the message vanished from Chat View and only came back later.

What changed:
- A confirmed echo retires only once its own transcript row is known: a drawn row, or the turn's rows bound after Claude took the message. A reply from the previous turn no longer retires it.
- The waiting copy and the transcript line go through the same normalization, so a live mention marker the user did not type (`@Name{live-xxxx}`), a slash command wrapped in `<command-message>`/`<command-args>` tags, and a long paste collapsed to `[Pasted text #N +M lines]` are still one message. A failed match never draws the message twice and never hides it.
- A queue copy the reader cut short, or one Claude collapsed to a paste placeholder, merges into the waiting row instead of showing a second one.
- Waiting stays waiting: only a real failure shows Not sent. Resync and the startup cleanup of old confirmed echoes keep their existing behavior.

Tests: `node --test tools/chat-*.test.js` covers the new parity harness in `tools/chat-hidden-pending.test.js` plus the mention and slash-command cases, with controls that fail when the row gate or the matcher is removed. `zig build -Dtarget=x86_64-windows-gnu` passes.
